OSMO will have a total supply of 1 billion. The initial released supply of OSMO is 100 million, split evenly between fairdrop recipients and the strategic reserve. After launch, newly released tokens will be distributed on the following basis:
Recipient
Reward
Liquidity Mining Incentives
45%
Staking Rewards
25%
Developer Vesting
25%
Community Pool
5%
OSMO will be highly inflationary in the beginning. Over time, the initial released supply of OSMO will only account for a small percentage of the total supply.
